results.sql: SELECT c.id AS client_id, c.name, COALESCE(p.avg_delay, 0) AS avg_delay, COALESCE(profit.total_margin, 0) AS total_margin, COALESCE(profit.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue FROM clients c LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.id AS client_id, AVG(julianday(p.paid_on) - julianday(i.issued_on)) AS avg_delay FROM invoices i JOIN payments p ON i.id = p.invoice_id JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.id WHERE i.issued_on >= '2026-10-01' AND i.status = 'issued' GROUP BY c.id) p ON c.id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.client_id, SUM(ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price - ol.unit_cost)) AS total_margin, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.client_id HAVING SUM(ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price - ol.unit_cost)) > 0.25 * SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price)) profit ON c.id = profit.client_id ORDER BY (profit.total_margin / profit.total_revenue) DESC LIMIT 5
